title: The First Cold
summary: The Quiet Winter, chapter one. A single flake of snow falls over the lake in the land of eternal summer. He is delighted. She recognises it, and says nothing.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley in warm golden light, silver waterfalls into the still lake, wildflowers through the grass. Nothing moves but the water. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The warrior walks along the lake path, small in the frame, unhurried, at ease. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face in warm light, easy, half a smile. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Three hundred summers, she says, and I have stopped counting them. It turns out a man can get used to anything, even to being happy.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of the golden valley over the water — and one small flurry of snow falling over the lake, the only cold thing in a warm frame. It does not melt. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face tilted up, watching something small fall, delighted and puzzled at once. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Niamh. Come out and look at this. Either the sky is broken or it is snowing in the country where nothing ends.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The princess comes along the path by the lake, small in the frame, looking up as she walks. Static camera.
Wide two shot. The two of them on the grass by the water, faces to the sky, the waterfall behind them. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face tipped back, eyes shut, a flake landing and staying on her lashes. For one breath she is only enjoying it. Static camera.

dialogue.line: It touches you and then it stays. Rain never stays. No wonder your people wrote songs about it — it is weather that wants to be kept.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face in warm light, watching the flake fall — and something behind her eyes closing like a door. Static camera.

dialogue.line: So it is. Snow. I have read of it in your songs. It is prettier than the songs let on, and colder.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face, boyish, catching a flake on his open palm held low and out of frame. Static camera.

dialogue.line: At home this meant the year was dying. Here it can only be a wonder. Nothing dies here. You told me so the first morning, and I have been living on it since.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. She makes the smile arrive. It takes a moment longer than it should. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then let it be a wonder. Stand in it with me and we will not ask it any questions tonight.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them in the first thin snow, breath visible, the valley whitening softly around them. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face, snow in his hair, laughing quietly at something he has just thought of. Static camera.

dialogue.line: My father would not believe a word of this. Snow in paradise and a princess to watch it with. He would say I dreamed it, and he would be half right.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The warrior walks away through the snow leaving a line of footprints, small in the white, easy. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The princess stands alone by the frozen falls, small in the white, quite still. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face alone, the warmth gone from the light, snow falling past her. She says it to nobody. Static camera.

dialogue.line: The land does not dream on its own. It listens. Something in this valley is homesick, and there are only two hearts in it, and it is not mine.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley under first snow, the falls thinning to ice-glass, the lake dark among white banks, nobody in the frame. Static camera.
